title: A dual theory of twisted Zhu's theory
summary: The notion of admissible $g$-twisted $V$-comodules is investigated for a graded vertex operator coalgebra $V$ and a finite order automorphism $g\in \Aut V$. We prove that $\mathcal {M}$ is an admissible $g$-twisted $V$-comodule if and only if its graded dual $\mathcal {M}'$ is an admissible $g^{-1}$-twisted $V'$-module for vertex operator algebra $V'$. Then we establish a dual theory of twisted Zhu's theory, i.e., there is a coassociative coalgebra $C_g(V)$ for a graded vertex operator coalgebra $V$, any admissible $g$-twisted $V$-comodule gives a $C_g(V)$-comodule, and vice versa.
